```{r tidying metadata, include=FALSE}

luad_clinical_data <- all_clinical_data %>% 
  filter(acronym == "LUAD") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~if_else(
    str_detect(.x, regex("(Not Applicable|Available)")) | .x == "",
    NA_character_,
    .x))) %>% 
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  mutate(days_to_last_followup = as.numeric(days_to_last_followup),
         days_to_death = as.numeric(days_to_death),
         status = if_else(vital_status == "Alive", 0, 1),
         time = if_else(vital_status == "Alive", days_to_last_followup, days_to_death)) %>% 
  filter(!(time <= 0)) %>% #removes all people with no follow up even one dead
  filter(!is.na(time))

luad_clinical_features <- luad_clinical_data %>%
  mutate(pathologic_stage = case_when(
    pathologic_stage %in% c("Stage I", "Stage IA", "Stage IB") ~ "Stage I",
    pathologic_stage %in% c("Stage II", "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB") ~ "Stage II",
    pathologic_stage %in% c("Stage IIIA", "Stage IIIB") ~ "Stage III",
    pathologic_stage %in% c("Stage IV") ~ "Stage IV"),
    
    tobacco_smoking_history = case_when( 
      tobacco_smoking_history %in% 
        c("Lifelong Non-smoker") ~ "Non-smoker",
      tobacco_smoking_history %in% 
        c("Current reformed smoker for > 15 years", 
          "Current reformed smoker for < or = 15 years", 
          "Current Reformed Smoker, Duration Not Specified") ~ "Former smoker",
      tobacco_smoking_history %in% 
        c("Current smoker") ~ "Current smoker"),
    age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis = as.numeric(age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)
  ) %>% 
  select(bcr_patient_barcode, gender, age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis, pathologic_stage, tobacco_smoking_history, status, time) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(gender, pathologic_stage, tobacco_smoking_history), as.factor)) %>% 
  drop_na()

```

```{r cleaning-luad-data}
  mutate(sample_code = substr(samples, 14, 15),
         samples = substr(samples, 1, 12)) %>%
```

```{r weighted embeddings}

triangular_weights <- tibble(
  top    = paste0("top", 1:10),
  weight = c(10/55, 9/55, 8/55, 7/55, 6/55, 5/55, 4/55, 3/55, 2/55, 1/55) 
)

weights <- tibble(
  top    = paste0("top", 1:10),
  weight = c(1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10, 1/10) 
)

calculate_weighted_embeddings <- function(data, weights = NULL){
  data %>%
    rename_with(tolower, matches("\\.top\\d+$", ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols         = matches("\\.top\\d+$"),
      names_to     = c("gene", "top"),
      names_pattern = "(?i)^(.*?)\\.(top\\d+)$"
    ) %>%
    left_join(weights, by = "top") %>%
    group_by(samples, gene) %>%
    summarise(
      weighted_avg = sum(value * weight) / sum(weight), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = gene,
      values_from = weighted_avg,
      names_glue = "{gene}_weighted_avg"
    )} 

luad_esm2_wavg <- calculate_weighted_embeddings(luad_top10_weighting, weights) %>% 
  inner_join(luad_clinical_features_filtered %>% select(samples,time,status),
             join_by(samples))
```

```{r utility-functions}

censor_time_at <- function(data, cutoff = 3652.5/2){
  data %>% 
    mutate(status = ifelse(time <= cutoff & status == 1, 1, 0),
           time = pmin(time, cutoff))
}

prepare_matrix <- function(data) {
  x <- model.matrix(~ . - time - status - samples, data = data)[, -1]
  
  y <- Surv(data$time, data$status)
  list(x = x, y = y)
}
```

```{r feature-selection}

select_features_cox <- function(data, cutoff = 5*365.25, p_threshold = 0.05){
  data <- censor_time_at(data, cutoff)
  features <- setdiff(names(data), c("time", "status", "samples"))
  
  result <- map(features, function(feat) {
    formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste0("`", feat, "`")))
    fit <- coxph(formula, data = data)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    s <- summary(fit)
    tibble(
      feature  = feat,
      hr       = s$coefficients[1, "exp(coef)"],
      hr_lower = s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
      hr_upper = s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"],
      p_value  = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      year     = cutoff/365.25
    )
  }) %>% 
    list_rbind() %>% 
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
    arrange(p_adj)
  
  if (nrow(result) == 0) return(list(all = tibble(), selected = tibble()))
  
  # Selection logic (unchanged)
  selected <- if (any(result$feature == "pathologic_stage")) {
    result
  } else if (any(result$p_value < p_threshold)) {
    result %>% filter(p_value < p_threshold)
  } else {
    result %>% slice_head(n = 10)
  }
  
  # Return both — all stats for plotting, filtered for modelling
  list(all = result, selected = selected)
}

```

```{r create-feature-set}
plan(sequential)
create_feature_sets <- function(clinical, binary, esm2_wavg,
                                sel_binary, sel_esm2,
                                cutoff) {
  
  # Censor all base sets to this horizon
  clinical_c <- censor_time_at(clinical, cutoff)
  binary_c   <- censor_time_at(binary,   cutoff)
  esm2_c     <- censor_time_at(esm2_wavg, cutoff)
  
  binary_cols <- intersect(sel_binary, names(binary_c))
  esm2_cols   <- intersect(sel_esm2,   names(esm2_c))
  
  list(
    clinical = clinical_c,
    
    clinical_binary = clinical_c %>%
      left_join(
        binary_c %>% select(samples, all_of(binary_cols)),
        by = "samples"
      ),
    
    clinical_esm2 = clinical_c %>%
      left_join(
        esm2_c %>% select(samples, all_of(esm2_cols)),
        by = "samples"
      ),
    
    combined = clinical_c %>%
      left_join(
        binary_c %>% select(samples, all_of(binary_cols)),
        by = "samples"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        esm2_c %>% select(samples, all_of(esm2_cols)),
        by = "samples"
      )
  )
}

```

```{r model-fitting-functions}

fit_cox <- function(train_data) {
  train_data <- train_data %>% select(-samples)
  features   <- setdiff(names(train_data), c("time", "status"))
  formula    <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste0("`", features, "`", collapse = " + "))
  )
  coxph(formula, data = train_data)
}

fit_glmnet <- function(train_data, alpha = 1) {
  prep   <- prepare_matrix(train_data)
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(prep$x, prep$y, family = "cox", alpha = alpha)
  cv_fit
}

fit_rsf <- function(train_data, seed = 318) {
  train_data <- train_data %>%
    select(-samples) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  features <- setdiff(names(train_data), c("time", "status")) %>%
    paste0("`", ., "`")
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste(features, collapse = " + "))
  )
  rfsrc(
    formula,
    data      = as.data.frame(train_data),
    ntree     = 500,
    nodesize  = 5,
    seed      = seed,
    importance = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r functions-model-evaluation}

calculate_cindex_cox <- function(model, test_data) {
  lp <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, type = "lp")
  risk <- -as.numeric(lp)
  concordance(Surv(test_data$time, test_data$status) ~ risk)$concordance
}

calculate_cindex_glmnet <- function(model, test_data) {
  prep <- prepare_matrix(test_data)
  lp   <- as.numeric(predict(model, newx = prep$x, s = "lambda.min"))
  risk <- -as.numeric(lp)
  concordance(Surv(test_data$time, test_data$status) ~ risk)$concordance
}

calculate_cindex_rsf <- function(model, test_data) {
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = as.data.frame(test_data))
  risk <- -(pred$chf[, ncol(pred$chf)])
  concordance(Surv(test_data$time, test_data$status) ~ risk)$concordance
}
```


```{r alpha-tuning-function}
tune_alpha <- function(train_data, sel_feats, alpha_grid, n_folds = 3) {
  
  if (length(sel_feats) == 0) return(list(alpha = 1, mean_c = NA_real_))
  
  tr_fs <- train_data %>%
    select(samples, time, status, all_of(intersect(sel_feats, names(train_data))))
  
  # Guard: need enough events for inner CV
  if (sum(tr_fs$status) < n_folds * 2) return(list(alpha = 1, mean_c = NA_real_))
  
  folds <- vfold_cv(tr_fs, v = n_folds, strata = status)
  
  results <- map(alpha_grid, function(a) {
    fold_perf <- map_dbl(folds$splits, function(split) {
      tr_inner  <- analysis(split)
      val_inner <- assessment(split)
      
      # Guard against empty inner folds
      if (sum(tr_inner$status) < 3 || sum(val_inner$status) < 1) return(NA_real_)
      
      fit <- tryCatch(fit_glmnet(tr_inner, alpha = a), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
      
      tryCatch(calculate_cindex_glmnet(fit, val_inner), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    })
    tibble(alpha = a, mean_c = mean(fold_perf, na.rm = TRUE))
  }) %>% list_rbind()
  
  best <- results %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean_c)) %>%
    slice_max(mean_c, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(best) == 0) return(list(alpha = 1, mean_c = NA_real_))
  as.list(best)
}
```

```{r outer-folds}
outer_folds <- vfold_cv(luad_clean, v = 5, strata = status)

library(future)

plan(multisession, workers = 8)
```

```{r cv}

nested_results_test <- future_map(seq_along(outer_folds$splits) , function(fold_i) {
  message("Outer fold ", fold_i, " of ", nrow(outer_folds))
  outer_split <- outer_folds$splits[[fold_i]]
  
  outer_train_ids <- analysis(outer_split)$samples
  outer_test_ids  <- assessment(outer_split)$samples
  
  # Pull each data source for this fold
  train_binary   <- luad_clean %>% filter(samples %in% outer_train_ids)
  test_binary    <- luad_clean %>% filter(samples %in% outer_test_ids)
  
  train_clinical <- luad_clinical_features_filtered %>%
    filter(samples %in% outer_train_ids)
  test_clinical  <- luad_clinical_features_filtered %>%
    filter(samples %in% outer_test_ids)
  
  train_esm2 <- luad_esm2_wavg %>% filter(samples %in% outer_train_ids)
  test_esm2  <- luad_esm2_wavg %>% filter(samples %in% outer_test_ids)
  
  map(names(time_horizons), function(t_name) {
    
    cutoff <- as.numeric(time_horizons[[t_name]])
    message("  Time horizon: ", t_name)
    
    sel_bin_out <- select_features_cox(train_binary, cutoff)
    sel_esm_out <- select_features_cox(train_esm2,   cutoff)
    
    # For modelling (unchanged behaviour)
    sel_bin <- sel_bin_out$selected$feature
    sel_esm <- sel_esm_out$selected$feature
    
    # For tracking — now uses ALL features, not just significant ones
    feature_tracking <- bind_rows(
      sel_bin_out$all %>% mutate(source = "binary"),
      sel_esm_out$all %>% mutate(source = "esm2")
    ) %>%
      mutate(fold = fold_i, time_horizon = t_name)
    # Clinical features always selected by select_features_cox logic
    # (pathologic_stage anchor means all clinical features are returned)
    
    # Build feature sets — data is censored inside this function
    train_sets <- create_feature_sets(
      train_clinical, train_binary, train_esm2,
      sel_bin, sel_esm, cutoff
    )
    test_sets <- create_feature_sets(
      test_clinical, test_binary, test_esm2,
      sel_bin, sel_esm, cutoff
    )
    
    map(names(train_sets), function(fs) {
      
      message("    Feature set: ", fs)
      tr <- train_sets[[fs]]
      te <- test_sets[[fs]]
      
      message("---- DEBUG ----")
      message("Fold: ", fold_i,
              " | FS: ", fs,
              " | Horizon: ", t_name)
      
      message("Train events: ", sum(tr$status))
      message("Test events: ", sum(te$status))
      message("Num features: ", ncol(tr) - 3)
      
      # Require at least time + status + 1 predictor + 2 events in train
      n_events <- sum(tr$status == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_feats  <- ncol(tr) - 3  # subtract samples, time, status
      if (n_feats == 0 || n_events < 5) {
        message("    Skipping — insufficient features or events")
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      # Features available in this set (excludes samples/time/status)
      feats_in_set <- setdiff(names(tr), c("samples", "time", "status"))
      
      best_alpha <- tune_alpha(tr, feats_in_set, alpha_grid, 3)$alpha
      message("    Best alpha: ", best_alpha)
      
      # Fit models — data already censored, no further censoring needed
      cox_fit <- tryCatch(fit_cox(tr),               error = function(e) NULL)
      glm_fit <- tryCatch(fit_glmnet(tr, best_alpha), error = function(e) NULL)
      rsf_fit <- tryCatch(fit_rsf(tr),               error = function(e) NULL)
      
      # Evaluate on test set (also pre-censored at same cutoff)
      cox_c <- if (!is.null(cox_fit))
        tryCatch(calculate_cindex_cox(cox_fit, te),    error = function(e) NA_real_)
      else NA_real_
      
      glm_c <- if (!is.null(glm_fit))
        tryCatch(calculate_cindex_glmnet(glm_fit, te), error = function(e) NA_real_)
      else NA_real_
      
      rsf_c <- if (!is.null(rsf_fit))
        tryCatch(calculate_cindex_rsf(rsf_fit, te),    error = function(e) NA_real_)
      else NA_real_
      
      # --- Predictions ---
      predictions <- list()
      
      if (!is.null(cox_fit)) {
        lp <- predict(cox_fit, newdata = te, type = "lp")
        predictions$cox <- tibble(
          samples = te$samples,
          risk = as.numeric(lp),
          model = "cox"
        )
      }
      
      if (!is.null(glm_fit)) {
        prep_te <- prepare_matrix(te)
        lp <- predict(glm_fit, newx = prep_te$x, s = "lambda.min")
        predictions$glmnet <- tibble(
          samples = te$samples,
          risk = as.numeric(lp),
          model = "glmnet"
        )
      }
      
      if (!is.null(rsf_fit)) {
        pred <- predict(rsf_fit, newdata = as.data.frame(te))
        predictions$rsf <- tibble(
          samples = te$samples,
          risk = pred$predicted,
          model = "rsf"
        )
      }
      
      pred_df <- bind_rows(predictions) %>%
        mutate(
          fold = fold_i,
          time_horizon = t_name,
          feature_set = fs
        ) %>%
        left_join(te %>% select(samples, time, status), by = "samples")
      
      if (!is.null(pred_df)) {
        message("Risk summary:")
        print(summary(pred_df$risk))
      }
      
      if (!is.null(pred_df)) {
        c1 <- concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ risk, data = pred_df)$concordance
        c2 <- concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ I(-risk), data = pred_df)$concordance
        
        message("C-index: ", round(c1, 3),
                " | Flipped: ", round(c2, 3))
      }
      
      #Feature Importance
      importance_list <- list()
      
      # GLMNET: non-zero coefficients at lambda.min
      if (!is.null(glm_fit)) {
        coefs <- coef(glm_fit, s = "lambda.min")
        coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coefs))
        colnames(coef_df) <- "coefficient"
        coef_df$feature <- rownames(coef_df)
        importance_list$glmnet <- coef_df %>%
          filter(coefficient != 0, feature != "(Intercept)") %>%
          transmute(
            feature,
            importance = abs(coefficient),
            model      = "glmnet"
          )
      }
      
      # RSF: built-in variable importance
      if (!is.null(rsf_fit)) {
        imp <- rsf_fit$importance
        importance_list$rsf <- tibble(
          feature    = names(imp),
          importance = as.numeric(imp),
          model      = "rsf"
        )
      }
      
      importance_df <- bind_rows(importance_list) %>%
        mutate(
          fold         = fold_i,
          time_horizon = t_name,
          feature_set  = fs
        )
      list(
        performance = tibble(
          fold         = fold_i,
          time_horizon = t_name,
          feature_set  = fs,
          best_alpha   = best_alpha,
          n_train      = nrow(tr),
          n_events     = n_events,
          n_features   = n_feats,
          cox_c        = cox_c,
          glmnet_c     = glm_c,
          rsf_c        = rsf_c
        ),
        
        predictions = pred_df,
        
        features = tibble(
          fold = fold_i,
          time_horizon = t_name,
          feature_set = fs,
          feature = feats_in_set
        ),
        
        pvals = feature_tracking,
        
        importance = importance_df
      )
    }) 
    
  }) 
  
}, .options = furrr_options(seed = 318))

```

```{r result}

results_final <- performance %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(cox_c, glmnet_c, rsf_c),
    names_to  = "model",
    values_to = "c_index"
  ) %>%
  group_by(feature_set, model, time_horizon) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_c = mean(c_index,              na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_c   = sd(c_index,               na.rm = TRUE),
    lower  = quantile(c_index, 0.025,  na.rm = TRUE),
    upper  = quantile(c_index, 0.975,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_folds_complete = sum(!is.na(c_index)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_c))

print(results_final)

save(nested_results, results_final, nested_results_test, file = "cv_results.RData")
```

```{r consistent-graph-theme}

theme_dissertation <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      #Text
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold",   size = 11, family = "Arial"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10, family = "Arial"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 11, family = "Arial"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 10, family = "Arial"),
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, family = "Arial"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10, family = "Arial"),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, family = "Arial"),
      
      #Panel
      strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      
      # Margins — prevents clipping on Word export
      plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 15, b = 8, l = 8, unit = "pt")
    )
}
```

```{r prediction-model}

risk_results <- predictions %>% 
  
  filter(model %in% c("rsf", "glmnet")) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    feature_set = recode(feature_set,
                         "clinical"        = "Clinical",
                         "clinical_binary" = "Clinical + Binary",
                         "clinical_esm2"   = "Clinical + ESM2",
                         "combined"        = "Combined"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  filter(time_horizon %in% c("3yr", "5yr")) %>%
  
  group_by(model, feature_set, time_horizon, fold) %>%
  mutate(risk_scaled = scale(risk)[,1]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  group_by(model, feature_set, time_horizon) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      risk_scaled > median(risk_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
      "High risk",
      "Low risk"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plots <- risk_results %>%
  group_split(model, feature_set, time_horizon) %>%
  map(~ {
    
    df <- .x
    
    fit <- survfit2(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = df)
    
    ggsurvfit(fit) +
      add_confidence_interval() +
      add_pvalue() +
      
      labs(
        title = paste(
          unique(df$model),
          "|",
          unique(df$feature_set),
          "|",
          unique(df$time_horizon)
        ),
        x = "Time (years)",
        y = "Survival probability"
      ) +
      
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("Low risk" = "#1f77b4", "High risk" = "#d62728") 
      ) +
      
      theme_bw()
  })

wrap_plots(plots)
```

```{r risk-one-per-feature-set}

risk_results_fs <- predictions %>% 
  
  filter(model %in% c("rsf", "glmnet")) %>% 
  filter((model == "glmnet" & feature_set == "clinical")|
           (model == "rsf" & feature_set == "clinical_binary")|
           (model == "rsf" & feature_set == "clinical_esm2")|
           (model == "rsf" & feature_set == "combined")) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    feature_set = recode(feature_set,
                         "clinical"        = "Clinical",
                         "clinical_binary" = "Clinical + Binary",
                         "clinical_esm2"   = "Clinical + ESM2",
                         "combined"        = "Combined"
    ),
    model = recode(model,
                   "rsf"        = "RSF",
                   "glmnet" = "Regularized Cox")) %>%
  
  filter(time_horizon %in% c("5yr")) %>%
  
  group_by(model, feature_set, time_horizon, fold) %>%
  mutate(risk_scaled = scale(risk)[,1]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  group_by(model, feature_set, time_horizon) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      risk_scaled > median(risk_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
      "High risk",
      "Low risk"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(time_years = time / 365.25) 

plots_feature_sets <- risk_results_fs %>%
  group_split(model, feature_set) %>%
  map(~ {
    df  <- .x
    fit <- survfit2(Surv(time_years, status) ~ group, data = df)

    p <- ggsurvfit(fit, linewidth = 0.9, theme = theme_dissertation()) +
      add_confidence_interval(alpha = 0.12) +
      add_risktable(
        risktable_stats = "n.risk",
        theme = list(
          theme_risktable_default(),
          theme(
            text      = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 10),
            axis.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 10),
            plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 10, face = "bold")
          )
        )
      ) +
      add_pvalue(
        caption  = "Log-rank {p.value}",
        location = "annotation",
        x        = 0.05,
        y        = 0.08,
        size     = 10 / .pt,
        hjust    = 0,
        family   = "Arial"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5, limits = c(0, 5)) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("Low risk" = "#1f78b4", "High risk" = "#e31a1c"),
        name   = "Risk group"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Low risk" = "#1f78b4", "High risk" = "#e31a1c"),
        name   = "Risk group"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(unique(df$feature_set), " (", unique(df$model), ")"),
        x     = "Time (years)",
        y     = "Survival probability"
      ) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          face   = "bold",
          size   = 11,
          family = "Arial",
          hjust  = 0.5
        )
      )

    ggplotify::as.ggplot(p)   
  })

km_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_feature_sets, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves Stratified by Predicted Risk Group at 5 Years",
    subtitle = "Patients separated into high and low risk groups by median predicted risk score",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, family = "Arial"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10, family = "Arial"),
      legend.position = "bottom"),
    tag_levels = "A"
  ) 

ggsave("figure_km.png",
       plot = km_plot,
       width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

```


```{r top-features}
clinical_features <- importance %>% 
  filter(feature_set == "clinical") %>% 
  pull(unique(feature)) %>% 
  unique()

top_features <- importance %>%
  group_by(fold, time_horizon, feature_set, model) %>%
  slice_max(importance, n = 15) %>%
  ungroup()

feature_stability <- top_features %>%
  count(feature, model, feature_set, time_horizon, name = "n_folds_selected") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_folds_selected)) %>% 
  filter(feature_set == "clinical_binary"|
           feature_set == "clinical_esm2") %>% 
  filter(!(feature %in% clinical_features)) %>% 
  filter(time_horizon == "5yr") %>% 
  filter(n_folds_selected >= 3)

feature_stability_plot <- feature_stability %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = str_remove(feature, "_weighted_avg$"),
    feature_label = str_replace_all(feature_label, "_", " "),
    feature_label = str_to_upper(feature_label),
    feature_set_label = case_when(
      feature_set == "clinical_binary" ~ "Clinical + Binary",
      feature_set == "clinical_esm2"   ~ "Clinical + ESM2",
      TRUE ~ feature_set
    ),
    model_label = case_when(
      model == "glmnet" ~ "Regularized Cox",
      model == "rsf"    ~ "RSF",
      TRUE ~ model
    )
  )

feature_stability_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x    = n_folds_selected,
    y    = tidytext::reorder_within(feature_label, n_folds_selected, feature_set_label),
    fill = model_label
  )) +
  geom_col(
    position  = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width     = 0.65,
    colour    = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1:5,
    colour     = "grey90",
    linewidth  = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:5,
    limits = c(0, 5.5),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    name   = "Number of folds in which feature was selected (out of 5)"
  ) +
  tidytext::scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_fill_npg() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ feature_set_label,
    nrow   = 2,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    y        = NULL,
    fill     = "Model",
    title    = "Feature Selection Stability Across Cross-Validation Folds at 5 Years",
    subtitle = "Features selected in ≥ 3 of 5 outer folds shown, clinical features excluded"
  ) +
  theme_dissertation()            

ggsave("figure_stability.png",
       width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
